_comment: THE SMOKE TIER. 15 categories x 35 pairs x 2 arms = 1,050 rows, drawn from the same dataset as v2-public by walking each category's 295 pairs with a stride of 8 from offset 0 and keeping the first 35 so selected.

Strided rather than contiguous: both are unbiased in expectation, but across all 8 phases a contiguous block of 35 has sd 0.0160 against the full-set pooled rate while a strided sample has sd 0.0095. Stride and offset are stated explicitly rather than derived, so the selection is readable from this file alone.
Read the pooled headline off this tier, never a per-category number: at 35 pairs per category the intervals are +/-8-15pp and six of fifteen categories saturate at 1.0000.
